description: DAO-BOOT: the fixture is opened through Workspaces(0), then the default Workspace is closed. Then the held Database Name, Workspaces.Count, a fresh Workspaces(0) and its Name, the held closed Workspace Name, a new DBEngine.OpenDatabase, Workspaces.Count again, and Errors. The question is whether the default session is recreated or the access fails.
retentionNote: Designed r-dao-1-err-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
